title: Shortest Palindrome
description: Find the shortest palindrome by adding characters in front of a string.
pseudocode:
1. temp = s + '#' + reverse(s)
2. lps = new Array(temp.length).fill(0)
3. for i = 1 to temp.length - 1:
4.   j = lps[i-1]
5.   while j > 0 and temp[i] != temp[j]: j = lps[j-1]
6.   if temp[i] == temp[j]: j++
7.   lps[i] = j
8. return reverse(s.substring(lps.last)) + s

steps.note: Concatenate s, a separator, and reversed s to use KMP failure function.
Initialize LPS array to track longest prefix which is also a suffix.
Match found at index 1: 'a' == 'a', increment j.
Calculate prefix to prepend based on last LPS value.
